items.summary: ドイツのインディースタジオReijaは，人気ストリーマーZizaran氏らと共同開発する新作アクションRPG「Blastheim」を発表した。別の作業をしながらサブモニターで遊べる作品で，放置系RPGの手軽さと本格的なハック＆スラッシュの奥深さを融合させるという。

zh.title: 宣布制作第二屏新动作角色扮演游戏《Blastheim》。 《流亡之路》知名主播参与开发
zh.summary: 德国独立工作室 Reija 宣布推出一款新动作角色扮演游戏《Blastheim》，该游戏是与流行主播 Zizaran 等人共同开发的。这是一款可以在执行其他任务的同时在辅助显示器上玩的作品，据说结合了闲置 RPG 的轻松性和成熟的砍杀游戏的深度。

en.title: Announced the production of a new action RPG "Blastheim" for second screen. Famous streamers of “Path of Exile” participate in development
en.summary: German indie studio Reija has announced a new action RPG, ``Blastheim,'' co-developed with popular streamer Zizaran and others. It is a work that can be played on a secondary monitor while doing other tasks, and is said to combine the ease of an idle RPG with the depth of a full-fledged hack and slash.

items.title: WEBZENの新作は，3Dの空間表現と2Dドット絵を組み合わせたジオラマ・ピクセルアートが特徴の「ディフェンスゲームの暴君になった：LAST STAGE」［G-STAR 2026］

en.title: WEBZEN's new work is "I Became the Tyrant of the Defense Game: LAST STAGE" [G-STAR 2026], which features diorama pixel art that combines 3D spatial expression and 2D pixel art.

items.title: 《GTA6》遭M站玩家评测“差评轰炸”
items.summary: 随着《GTA6》的发售，游戏在 Metacritic 上遭到了玩家评测的差评轰炸。截至发稿前，游戏在 Metacritic 上的玩家评分仅为5.7分（满分10分）。 相较之下，《GTA6》在 Metacritic 的媒体评分为99分（满分100分），与《塞尔达传说：时之笛》并列历史第一。由于《GTA 6》收录的媒体评测数量接近《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的7倍，这一成就因此更具分量。 值得注意的是，Metacritic 允许任何人提交玩家评分，提交前也无需证明自己购买或游玩过该游戏。在必须购买游戏才能打分的主机平台上，《GTA6》PS5版的最新玩家评分为4.83分（满分5分），Xbox版则为4.9分

ja.title: 『GTA6』はMステでプレイヤーから「否定的なレビューを浴びせられた」
ja.summary: GTA 6 のリリースにより、このゲームは Metacritic のプレイヤー レビューから否定的なレビューにさらされました。本稿執筆時点で、Metacritic でのこのゲームのプレイヤー評価は 10 点中 5.7 点にすぎません。それに比べ、「GTA6」は Metacritic で 100 点中 99 点のメディア スコアを獲得しており、「ゼルダの伝説 時のオカリナ」と並んで史上 1 位にランクされています。 『GTA 6』に含まれるメディアレビューの数は『ゼルダの伝説 時のオカリナ』の7倍近くであるため、この成果はさらに重要です。 Metacritic では、送信前にゲームを購入またはプレイしたことを証明する必要がなく、誰でもプレイヤーの評価を送信できることは注目に値します。評価を受けるためにゲームを購入する必要があるコンソール プラットフォームでは、PS5 版「GTA6」の最新プレイヤー評価は 4.83 ポイント (5 点満点)、Xbox 版は 4.9 ポイントです。

en.title: "GTA6" was "bombarded with negative reviews" by players on M station
en.summary: With the release of GTA 6, the game was bombarded with negative reviews from player reviews on Metacritic. As of press time, the game's player rating on Metacritic is only 5.7 out of 10. In comparison, "GTA6" has a media score of 99 out of 100 on Metacritic, ranking first in history with "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time". This achievement is even more significant as the number of media reviews included in "GTA 6" is nearly 7 times that of "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time". It’s worth noting that Metacritic allows anyone to submit player ratings without having to prove that they have purchased or played the game before submitting. On console platforms where the game must be purchased to be rated, the latest player rating of the PS5 version of "GTA6" is 4.83 points (out of 5 points), while the Xbox version is 4.9 points

en.title: Nvidia announces Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as CEO
en.summary: On November 23, 2026, Nvidia announced that its board of directors had unanimously voted to immediately resume Huang’s duties as president, CEO and director. Previously, the board of directors had many communications and talks with Huang Renxun and recognized Huang Renxun’s candid attitude and leadership capabilities. During the decision-making process, the board of directors listened to the opinions of senior U.S. government officials and determined that Huang's reinstatement would not pose a national security risk. Harvey C. Jones, Chairman of the Board of Directors, will continue to serve as Chairman. He said that Huang Renxun is the right person to lead Nvidia, and his reinstatement is in the interests of shareholders, employees, partners and customers. At the same time, he thanked Colette Kress for her efforts as interim CEO, and Colette Kress will continue to serve as Nvidia's chief financial officer. Jen-Hsun Huang expressed his anticipation of returning to NVIDIA and getting back to work. He thanked the board of directors for their trust and prudence

en.title: Creator of "War Dogs": When I make games, I only care about the results and don't care what the outside world thinks.
en.summary: Joe Brammer once had to lie to get into the gaming industry. In early 2014, a few months before graduating from the University of Derby, Brammer applied to join the then-new ID@Xbox programme. ID@Xbox is an independent game developer support program officially launched by Microsoft in 2014. Through it, budding developers can present project proposals to Microsoft and will have the opportunity to receive two Xbox One development machines and a license to use Unreal Engine for free. "I've wanted to make my own games since I was 11 years old, and I had done mods for Battlefield," Bramer recalled.
